verdict.rationale: The skills are published as plain SKILL.md markdown files in a public folder tree (skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md and others). The installer writes them into your repo as ordinary editable files you own, and the same set is offered for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. A hands-on probe confirmed a `--copy` install wrote a readable SKILL.md with clean frontmatter into ./.claude/skills/tdd/. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation of moving the same files into a second, non-Claude harness; the optional plugin route instead ships a read-only managed bundle.
